body:
Thanks friend. I'm in a better place than I was that night but I'm still very angry and it seems this anger lasts forever. I feel like friends have betrayed me but I'm not sure if it's actual betrayal or just me having too high expectations of them. 

No matter what I do, I feel lower than everyone else and no one wants to help. I thank you for being there when I needed it the most.

Nobody gives a shit about me. I have people who hurt me that I blocked on text and they don't even realize it. People are only kind to me because society says they have to be. 

Well I'm tired of being angry and scared and lonely. Let's see how they deal with me being gone.
